title: HighlightReel
description: The highlights reel in a bundle's match.json (`highlights`), written by ninety-e2e --match: every confident detected goal and the saves that made the cut (ninety/highlights.py, docs/eval/highlights-plan.md), each with the fan's label code gave it, a caption (ninety/agents/captioner.py) and its recording from the footage. Times are match seconds; files are relative to the bundle. Reads detected events only, never the answer key. A UI shows a moment once the match clock has passed `clip[1]`, so it never shows a goal before the broadcast does.

save_filter.description: True once the measurement passed its gates: only saves that beat a keeper's dive are in. False: every save is in.

labels.description: True once vision's errors are measured; until then every label is GOAL or SAVE.

origins.description: True once how an attack began (origin) has been graded against the answer key; until then every moment's origin is null and no caption or screen says how an attack began.

saves_by_pace.description: The saves' event ids, fastest flight first.

problem.description: Why the code caption stayed; null when the model's aired.

unavailable.description: The error type when the model could not be reached; never its message.

team.description: Null unless the shot's side was told surely (factcheck.side_known): a UI says 'a player'.

player.description: The shooter's track (h-t12); null unless the side was told surely, since a track names its side.

origin.description: How the shooting side's possession began (docs/eval/highlights-plan.md, Amendment 2): the restart the detector saw (ninety/vision/restarts.py), else the one inferred from the ball going out, or open_play when the ball was won back. Null when its start was not seen.

label_detail.description: The number that earned the label, as shown ("112 km/h"); null for GOAL and SAVE.

d_m.description: From the strike to the centre of the goal attacked.

clip.description: The moment's window: its build-up to just after the shot.

caption_source.description: model: the Captioner's line, passed by the fact-checking agent. code: the code-written line.

recording.description: The moment in the footage; null when its window is wholly outside it.

images.description: The clip images it covers, [first, end).

video_t.description: The same, in the bundle footage's own seconds.

clip.description: The window as VP9 video; null when the bundle ships frames, not video.
